module: Flowgraph node "On Vehicle Shopping Event" (category repeat_instant, ui color/icon). Detects career vehicle shopping events. Impulse outputs: openedMenu, closedMenu (also raised when returning to the game), vehicleSpawned (vehicle generated for inspection), openedDetail (detailed shopping menu), vehicleBought; plus vehId (number, id of the purchased vehicle) and testDriveActive (bool, career_modules_testDrive.isActive).
notes: Uses career_modules_testDrive and career_modules_inventory: requires career.
The descriptions of vehicleBought and vehId contain typos in the game ("buyign").
vehId keeps its last value after the impulse.

work.desc: Every frame: sets five flow outputs back to false, applies and clears the flags, updates testDriveActive.

onVehicleAddedToInventory.desc: Hook: raises vehicleBought and converts data.inventoryId into a vehicle id (vehId).

onUIPlayStateChanged.desc: Hook: raises closedMenu when the player returns to the game.

enteredPlay.desc: true if entering the play state
